🚨 Traffic Advisory – Route 9W Northbound, Upper Grandview New York🚨

The U.S. Route 9W  in the area of Upper Grandview New York currently has several large potholes that are causing damage to passing vehicles.

The New York State Department of Transportation has been notified of the condition and are responding to address the situation.

⚠️ Motorists are advised to:
· Avoid the area if possible and seek alternate routes.
· If alternate routes are not available, use extreme caution when traveling through the area.
· Reduce speed and remain alert for roadway hazards.
Please drive safely and allow extra travel time.
